bindings.protocol_definitions: proofs/m6/NestedSession.lean: exampleProtocol (legacy depth-only control), balancedProtocol (bounded return stack), choiceProtocol, offerProtocol (external choice)
bindings.queue_accounting: depth derived from the enqueued/dequeued ledger, never stored beside it
bindings.absent_bindings_reason: This model proves grammar, duality and endpoint-resource theorems over a handwritten closed definitions table. No lowering helper, runtime or peer is a subject of these theorems, so binding one would imply a correspondence this package does not establish. WIT-SESSION-06 stays open.

claims.progress: one guest step: an open endpoint whose resolved node declares the action has a successor, and the environment-aware step succeeds under explicit queue, peer, scheduler and host premises, each shown load-bearing; termination, fairness, eventual delivery and deadlock freedom are unclaimed
claims.cancellation: an event class that cuts the committed prefix; it carries no endpoint or session transition
claims.nested_recursion: the balanced table's unbounded trace language sendⁿ·recvⁿ is not regular and needs the return stack; this model admits it only up to the declared stack limit, and the dropped-continuation mutant accepts an unbalanced trace and refuses a balanced one; no runtime correspondence
claims.type_equality: strong equality of guest-visible traces and orderly ends over the stack-aware semantics, decided by a memoised pair exploration that spends one unit of a declared work bound per pair; an exhausted bound is refused, an equal verdict is proved to be trace equivalence, a differ verdict carries a proved witness trace, and duality is equality with the dual table; no bound is proved sufficient for every protocol

theorems.name: NestedSession.dual_is_involutive
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: duality is definitional and involutive on every node
theorems.statement: NestedSession.dual_is_involutive : ∀ (node : NestedSession.Node), NestedSession.dual (NestedSession.dual node) = node

theorems.name: NestedSession.dual_swaps_send_and_recv
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: duality swaps Send/Recv on the same ordered message type
theorems.statement: NestedSession.dual_swaps_send_and_recv : ∀ (message : NestedSession.MessageType) (continuation : Nat), NestedSession.dual (NestedSession.Node.send message continuation) = NestedSession.Node.recv message continuation

theorems.name: NestedSession.dual_swaps_choose_and_offer
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: internal choice duals to external choice on the same branch
theorems.statement: NestedSession.dual_swaps_choose_and_offer : ∀ (branch continuation : Nat), NestedSession.dual (NestedSession.Node.choose branch continuation) = NestedSession.Node.offer branch continuation

theorems.name: NestedSession.resolve_refuses_exhaustion
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: bounded unfolding refuses a nested constructor at depth zero instead of accepting it
theorems.statement: NestedSession.resolve_refuses_exhaustion : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (index name parameter : Nat), definitions[index]? = some (NestedSession.Node.nested name parameter) → NestedSession.resolve definitions 0 index = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.resolve_unfolds_with_depth
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: a nested constructor resolves to its named definition rather than expanding without bound
theorems.statement: NestedSession.resolve_unfolds_with_depth : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (index name parameter : Nat), definitions[index]? = some (NestedSession.Node.nested name parameter) → NestedSession.resolve definitions 1 index = definitions[name]?

theorems.name: NestedSession.resolve_refuses_unknown_definition
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: an index outside the closed table is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.resolve_refuses_unknown_definition : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (depth : Nat), NestedSession.resolve definitions depth definitions.length = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.send_step_does_not_observe_a_peer
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a send step observes no peer; receipt is not modelled
theorems.statement: NestedSession.send_step_does_not_observe_a_peer : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (depth : Nat) (endpoint successor : NestedSession.Endpoint), NestedSession.stepSend definitions depth endpoint = some successor → successor.responder = endpoint.responder ∧ successor.channel = endpoint.channel

theorems.name: NestedSession.endpoint_copy_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: endpoint copy is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.endpoint_copy_is_refused : ∀ (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint), NestedSession.copy endpoint = NestedSession.Outcome.refusedCopy

theorems.name: NestedSession.endpoint_discard_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: endpoint discard is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.endpoint_discard_is_refused : ∀ (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint), NestedSession.discard endpoint = NestedSession.Outcome.refusedDiscard

theorems.name: NestedSession.endpoint_capture_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: endpoint capture is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.endpoint_capture_is_refused : ∀ (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint), NestedSession.capture endpoint = NestedSession.Outcome.refusedCapture

theorems.name: NestedSession.stale_generation_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: identity alone does not authorise an operation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.stale_generation_is_refused : ∀ (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint), NestedSession.useWith endpoint endpoint.generation.succ = NestedSession.Outcome.refusedStale

theorems.name: NestedSession.matching_generation_is_accepted
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: the control keeping the refusal non-vacuous
theorems.statement: NestedSession.matching_generation_is_accepted : ∀ (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint), NestedSession.useWith endpoint endpoint.generation = NestedSession.Outcome.accepted

theorems.name: NestedSession.double_close_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: a second close is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.double_close_is_refused : ∀ (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint), NestedSession.closeOnce { channel := endpoint.channel, responder := endpoint.responder, protocol := endpoint.protocol, state := endpoint.state, generation := endpoint.generation, closed := true } = NestedSession.Outcome.refusedDoubleClose

theorems.name: NestedSession.closed_endpoint_cannot_send
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02/03: a closed endpoint cannot send
theorems.statement: NestedSession.closed_endpoint_cannot_send : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (depth : Nat) (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint) (message : NestedSession.MessageType) (continuation : Nat), NestedSession.resolve definitions depth endpoint.state = some (NestedSession.Node.send message continuation) → NestedSession.stepSend definitions depth { channel := endpoint.channel, responder := endpoint.responder, protocol := endpoint.protocol, state := endpoint.state, generation := endpoint.generation, closed := true } = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.send_step_advances_to_the_continuation
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04: one step advances exactly to the continuation and nothing outside the protocol
theorems.statement: NestedSession.send_step_advances_to_the_continuation : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (depth : Nat) (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint) (message : NestedSession.MessageType) (continuation : Nat), NestedSession.resolve definitions depth endpoint.state = some (NestedSession.Node.send message continuation) → NestedSession.stepSend definitions depth { channel := endpoint.channel, responder := endpoint.responder, protocol := endpoint.protocol, state := endpoint.state, generation := endpoint.generation, closed := false } = some { channel := endpoint.channel, responder := endpoint.responder, protocol := endpoint.protocol, state := continuation, generation := endpoint.generation, closed := false }

theorems.name: NestedSession.admitOne_is_bounded
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: admission keeps the mailbox depth inside the limit, given a well-formed session
theorems.statement: NestedSession.admitOne_is_bounded : ∀ (queued limit : Nat), queued ≤ limit → NestedSession.admitOne queued limit ≤ limit

theorems.name: NestedSession.admission_is_bounded
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a session admission never exceeds the declared queue limit
theorems.statement: NestedSession.admission_is_bounded : ∀ (session : NestedSession.Session), session.queued ≤ session.queueLimit → (NestedSession.deliver session).queued ≤ session.queueLimit

theorems.name: NestedSession.full_mailbox_is_unchanged
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a full mailbox refuses by leaving the session unchanged, never a silent drop
theorems.statement: NestedSession.full_mailbox_is_unchanged : ∀ (session : NestedSession.Session), session.queueLimit ≤ session.queued → NestedSession.deliver session = session

theorems.name: NestedSession.admission_preserves_the_endpoint_inventory
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: admission copies and removes no endpoint
theorems.statement: NestedSession.admission_preserves_the_endpoint_inventory : ∀ (session : NestedSession.Session), (NestedSession.deliver session).endpoints = session.endpoints

theorems.name: NestedSession.no_endpoint_duplication
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: no operation in this model increases the endpoint inventory
theorems.statement: NestedSession.no_endpoint_duplication : ∀ (session : NestedSession.Session), (NestedSession.deliver session).endpoints.length ≤ session.endpoints.length

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_send_then_recv
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: sequenced send advances the state and observes no peer
theorems.statement: NestedSession.trace_send_then_recv : Option.map (fun endpoint => endpoint.state) (NestedSession.stepSend NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }) = some 1

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_recursive_entry_unfolds_to_the_send_node
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: recursive entry unfolds to the declared definition instead of expanding
theorems.statement: NestedSession.trace_recursive_entry_unfolds_to_the_send_node : NestedSession.resolve NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 2 = some (NestedSession.Node.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64 1)

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_orderly_close
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: orderly close is accepted once and a second close is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.trace_orderly_close : NestedSession.closeOnce { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 3, generation := 4, closed := false } = NestedSession.Outcome.accepted ∧ NestedSession.closeOnce { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 3, generation := 4, closed := true } = NestedSession.Outcome.refusedDoubleClose

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_bounded_buffering_refuses_the_third_payload
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: bounded buffering stops at the declared limit
theorems.statement: NestedSession.trace_bounded_buffering_refuses_the_third_payload : (NestedSession.deliver (NestedSession.deliver (NestedSession.deliver { endpoints := [], queued := 0, queueLimit := 2 }))).queued = 2

theorems.name: NestedSession.send_events_never_observe
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a send event sequence carries no observation; send is never receipt
theorems.statement: NestedSession.send_events_never_observe : ∀ (operation identity : Nat), ((NestedSession.sendEvents operation identity).any fun event => match event with | NestedSession.Event.observation value => true | x => false) = false

theorems.name: NestedSession.receive_after_dequeue_is_well_formed
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: an observation preceded by a dequeue is a well-formed receive
theorems.statement: NestedSession.receive_after_dequeue_is_well_formed : NestedSession.dequeuedBefore [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.admission 1, NestedSession.Event.dequeue 1, NestedSession.Event.observation (some 7)] = true

theorems.name: NestedSession.forged_observation_without_dequeue_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: a forged peer response is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.forged_observation_without_dequeue_is_refused : NestedSession.dequeuedBefore [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.observation (some 7)] = false

theorems.name: NestedSession.orderly_close_with_cleanup_is_well_formed
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: close followed by cleanup is a well-formed orderly close
theorems.statement: NestedSession.orderly_close_with_cleanup_is_well_formed : NestedSession.orderlyCloseEvents [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.close, NestedSession.Event.cleanup 1] = true

theorems.name: NestedSession.close_without_cleanup_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: an omitted cleanup is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.close_without_cleanup_is_refused : NestedSession.orderlyCloseEvents [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.close] = false

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_send_then_recv_advances
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: send then receive advances through the closed table (the return half)
theorems.statement: NestedSession.trace_send_then_recv_advances : ((NestedSession.stepSend NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }).bind fun mid => NestedSession.stepRecv NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 mid) = some { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 2, generation := 4, closed := false }

theorems.name: NestedSession.closed_endpoint_cannot_receive
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02 negative control: receive-after-close is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.closed_endpoint_cannot_receive : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (depth : Nat) (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint) (message : NestedSession.MessageType) (continuation : Nat), NestedSession.resolve definitions depth endpoint.state = some (NestedSession.Node.recv message continuation) → NestedSession.stepRecv definitions depth { channel := endpoint.channel, responder := endpoint.responder, protocol := endpoint.protocol, state := endpoint.state, generation := endpoint.generation, closed := true } = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.both_choices_are_distinct_at_the_boundary
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01/03: internal choice branches stay distinct and a receive state does not step as a send
theorems.statement: NestedSession.both_choices_are_distinct_at_the_boundary : NestedSession.Node.choose 0 1 ≠ NestedSession.Node.choose 1 1 ∧ (NestedSession.stepSend NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 1, generation := 4, closed := false }).isNone = true

theorems.name: NestedSession.typed_send_advances_on_the_declared_type
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04: the matching ordered message type advances to the continuation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.typed_send_advances_on_the_declared_type : NestedSession.stepSendTyped NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } NestedSession.MessageType.i64 = some { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 1, generation := 4, closed := false }

theorems.name: NestedSession.wrong_message_type_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04 negative control: a wrong ordered message type is refused, not coerced
theorems.statement: NestedSession.wrong_message_type_is_refused : NestedSession.stepSendTyped NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } NestedSession.MessageType.text = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.wrong_order_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04 negative control: wrong order is refused in both directions
theorems.statement: NestedSession.wrong_order_is_refused : NestedSession.stepRecvTyped NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } NestedSession.MessageType.i64 = none ∧ NestedSession.stepSendTyped NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 1, generation := 4, closed := false } NestedSession.MessageType.i64 = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_internal_choice_branch_one
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: a declared internal branch advances to its continuation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.trace_internal_choice_branch_one : Option.map NestedSession.Endpoint.state (NestedSession.stepChoose NestedSession.choiceProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 2, generation := 4, closed := false } 1) = some 6

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_wrong_branch_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: a branch the protocol does not offer is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.trace_wrong_branch_is_refused : NestedSession.stepChoose NestedSession.choiceProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 2, generation := 4, closed := false } 0 = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.external_choice_is_not_guest_choice
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04: external choice is the peer’s, and its dual is an internal choice
theorems.statement: NestedSession.external_choice_is_not_guest_choice : (NestedSession.stepChoose [NestedSession.Node.offer 0 5] 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } 0).isNone = true ∧ NestedSession.dual (NestedSession.Node.offer 0 5) = NestedSession.Node.choose 0 5

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_internal_choice_branch_zero
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: the other declared internal branch (0) reaches its own continuation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.trace_internal_choice_branch_zero : Option.map NestedSession.Endpoint.state (NestedSession.stepChoose NestedSession.choiceProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 1, generation := 4, closed := false } 0) = some 5

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_external_choice_branch_zero
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: receiving external branch 0 reaches its typed i64 continuation and completes
theorems.statement: NestedSession.trace_external_choice_branch_zero : ((NestedSession.stepReceiveBranch NestedSession.offerProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } 0).bind fun mid => NestedSession.stepRecvTyped NestedSession.offerProtocol 2 mid NestedSession.MessageType.i64) = some { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 4, generation := 4, closed := false }

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_external_choice_branch_one
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: receiving external branch 1 reaches its typed bool continuation and completes
theorems.statement: NestedSession.trace_external_choice_branch_one : ((NestedSession.stepReceiveBranch NestedSession.offerProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 1, generation := 4, closed := false } 1).bind fun mid => NestedSession.stepRecvTyped NestedSession.offerProtocol 2 mid NestedSession.MessageType.bool) = some { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 4, generation := 4, closed := false }

theorems.name: NestedSession.undeclared_branch_receipt_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: a selection the offer node does not declare is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.undeclared_branch_receipt_is_refused : NestedSession.stepReceiveBranch NestedSession.offerProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } 1 = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.external_branch_keeps_its_typed_continuation
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: a received branch keeps its own typed continuation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.external_branch_keeps_its_typed_continuation : ((NestedSession.stepReceiveBranch NestedSession.offerProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } 0).bind fun mid => NestedSession.stepRecvTyped NestedSession.offerProtocol 2 mid NestedSession.MessageType.bool) = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.branch_receipt_is_refused_at_an_internal_choice
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04 negative control: receiving a selection is refused at an internal choice
theorems.statement: NestedSession.branch_receipt_is_refused_at_an_internal_choice : NestedSession.stepReceiveBranch NestedSession.choiceProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 1, generation := 4, closed := false } 0 = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.receipt_of_another_branch_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: at every offer node, receiving a branch other than the declared one has no continuation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.receipt_of_another_branch_is_refused : ∀ (declared continuation received : Nat), received ≠ declared → NestedSession.continuationOf (NestedSession.Action.receiveBranch received) (NestedSession.Node.offer declared continuation) = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.dualAction_is_involutive
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: the action dual is involutive
theorems.statement: NestedSession.dualAction_is_involutive : ∀ (action : NestedSession.Action), NestedSession.dualAction (NestedSession.dualAction action) = action

theorems.name: NestedSession.continuationOf_dual
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01/05: for every node and action, the dual action at the dual node declares exactly the same continuation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.continuationOf_dual : ∀ (action : NestedSession.Action) (node : NestedSession.Node), NestedSession.continuationOf (NestedSession.dualAction action) (NestedSession.dual node) = NestedSession.continuationOf action node

theorems.name: NestedSession.resolve_dual
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: resolving in the dual table is the dual of resolving, including through bounded unfolding
theorems.statement: NestedSession.resolve_dual : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (depth index : Nat), NestedSession.resolve (List.map NestedSession.dual definitions) depth index = Option.map NestedSession.dual (NestedSession.resolve definitions depth index)

theorems.name: NestedSession.step_on_the_dual_table
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: every step has the matching dual step on the dual table, for every table, depth, endpoint and action
theorems.statement: NestedSession.step_on_the_dual_table : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (depth : Nat) (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint) (action : NestedSession.Action), NestedSession.step (List.map NestedSession.dual definitions) depth endpoint (NestedSession.dualAction action) = NestedSession.step definitions depth endpoint action

theorems.name: NestedSession.dual_table_receives_the_selected_branch
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 fixture: the guest selection of branch 0 is the peer receipt of branch 0 on the dual table
theorems.statement: NestedSession.dual_table_receives_the_selected_branch : NestedSession.stepReceiveBranch (List.map NestedSession.dual NestedSession.choiceProtocol) 2 { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 1, generation := 4, closed := false } 0 = some { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 5, generation := 4, closed := false }

theorems.name: NestedSession.stack_external_choice_trace_is_accepted
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: the stack-aware operand accepts an external-choice trace that reaches finished with an empty stack
theorems.statement: NestedSession.stack_external_choice_trace_is_accepted : NestedSession.acceptedStackTrace NestedSession.offerProtocol { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 1 } [NestedSession.StackAction.receiveBranch 0, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64] = some { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 4, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 1 }

theorems.name: NestedSession.enqueue_raises_the_depth_by_one
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: an enqueue raises the derived depth by one under the ledger invariant
theorems.statement: NestedSession.enqueue_raises_the_depth_by_one : ∀ (box : NestedSession.Mailbox), box.dequeued ≤ box.enqueued → NestedSession.mailboxDepth (NestedSession.enqueue box) = NestedSession.mailboxDepth box + 1

theorems.name: NestedSession.dequeue_never_raises_the_depth
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: accounting cannot be inflated by dequeuing
theorems.statement: NestedSession.dequeue_never_raises_the_depth : ∀ (box : NestedSession.Mailbox), NestedSession.mailboxDepth (NestedSession.dequeue box) ≤ NestedSession.mailboxDepth box

theorems.name: NestedSession.dequeue_of_empty_mailbox_is_unchanged
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a dequeue of an empty mailbox leaves the ledger unchanged
theorems.statement: NestedSession.dequeue_of_empty_mailbox_is_unchanged : ∀ (box : NestedSession.Mailbox), NestedSession.mailboxDepth box = 0 → NestedSession.dequeue box = box

theorems.name: NestedSession.full_queue_misaccounting_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: an observation cannot borrow depth the ledger never recorded
theorems.statement: NestedSession.full_queue_misaccounting_is_refused : NestedSession.mailboxDepth (NestedSession.dequeue (NestedSession.dequeue { enqueued := 0, dequeued := 0 })) = 0 ∧ (NestedSession.dequeue { enqueued := 0, dequeued := 0 }).dequeued = 0

theorems.name: NestedSession.accounting_tracks_the_operations
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: the derived depth tracks admissions and dequeues
theorems.statement: NestedSession.accounting_tracks_the_operations : NestedSession.mailboxDepth (NestedSession.dequeue (NestedSession.enqueue (NestedSession.enqueue { enqueued := 0, dequeued := 0 }))) = 1

theorems.name: NestedSession.boundary_preserves_the_committed_prefix
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-06: cancellation, trap, quota exhaustion and peer disappearance only shorten a trace
theorems.statement: NestedSession.boundary_preserves_the_committed_prefix : ∀ (boundary : NestedSession.Boundary) (events : List NestedSession.Event), NestedSession.retainUntilBoundary boundary events <+: events

theorems.name: NestedSession.cancellation_keeps_its_own_event
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-06: a cancelled request stays visible in the retained prefix
theorems.statement: NestedSession.cancellation_keeps_its_own_event : NestedSession.retainUntilBoundary NestedSession.Boundary.cancellation [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.admission 1, NestedSession.Event.cancellation, NestedSession.Event.cleanup 1] = [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.admission 1]

theorems.name: NestedSession.peer_disappearance_keeps_the_cleanup_pending
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-06: an unobserved cleanup stays an unresolved fact
theorems.statement: NestedSession.peer_disappearance_keeps_the_cleanup_pending : NestedSession.cleanupPending NestedSession.Boundary.peerGone [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.close] = true

theorems.name: NestedSession.ordinary_close_does_not_keep_the_cleanup_pending
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-06 control: the pending fact is cleared only by an observed cleanup
theorems.statement: NestedSession.ordinary_close_does_not_keep_the_cleanup_pending : NestedSession.cleanupPending NestedSession.Boundary.peerGone [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.close, NestedSession.Event.cleanup 1] = false

theorems.name: NestedSession.quota_boundary_invents_nothing
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-06: a quota boundary neither completes a pending cleanup nor invents an observation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.quota_boundary_invents_nothing : NestedSession.retainUntilBoundary NestedSession.Boundary.quotaExhaustion [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.admission 1, NestedSession.Event.cancellation] <+: [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.admission 1, NestedSession.Event.cancellation] ∧ NestedSession.cleanupPending NestedSession.Boundary.quotaExhaustion [NestedSession.Event.guestRequest 0, NestedSession.Event.admission 1] = false

theorems.name: NestedSession.advance_preserves_the_endpoint_identity
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: the one step helper changes only the state
theorems.statement: NestedSession.advance_preserves_the_endpoint_identity : ∀ (endpoint successor : NestedSession.Endpoint) (continuation : Nat), NestedSession.advance endpoint continuation = some successor → NestedSession.sameIdentity successor endpoint = true

theorems.name: NestedSession.steppers_preserve_the_endpoint_identity
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: every stepper delegates its successor to the proven helper
theorems.statement: NestedSession.steppers_preserve_the_endpoint_identity : ∀ (endpoint successor : NestedSession.Endpoint) (continuation : Nat), NestedSession.advance endpoint continuation = some successor → NestedSession.sameIdentity successor endpoint = true

theorems.name: NestedSession.different_branches_are_different_traces
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: two internal branches are two traces over the event vocabulary
theorems.statement: NestedSession.different_branches_are_different_traces : NestedSession.choiceEvents 0 5 ≠ NestedSession.choiceEvents 1 5

theorems.name: NestedSession.branch_one_reaches_its_own_continuation
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: the declared branch reaches its own continuation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.branch_one_reaches_its_own_continuation : Option.map NestedSession.Endpoint.state (NestedSession.stepChoose NestedSession.branchingProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } 1) = some 2

theorems.name: NestedSession.branch_zero_refuses_a_bool_send
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: a branch the node does not declare is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.branch_zero_refuses_a_bool_send : NestedSession.stepChoose NestedSession.branchingProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } 0 = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.branch_one_accepts_the_bool_send
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: the declared branch keeps its own typed continuation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.branch_one_accepts_the_bool_send : Option.map NestedSession.Endpoint.state (NestedSession.stepSendTyped NestedSession.branchingProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 2, generation := 4, closed := false } NestedSession.MessageType.bool) = some 3

theorems.name: NestedSession.bounded_admission_is_bounded
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 full-queue accounting: a bounded admission never derives a depth past the declared limit, given the ledger invariant
theorems.statement: NestedSession.bounded_admission_is_bounded : ∀ (box : NestedSession.Mailbox) (limit : Nat) (reached : NestedSession.Mailbox), box.dequeued ≤ box.enqueued → NestedSession.boundedAdmit box limit = some reached → NestedSession.mailboxDepth reached ≤ limit

theorems.name: NestedSession.admission_at_the_limit_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 full-queue misaccounting: a mailbox at its limit refuses the next admission instead of recording it
theorems.statement: NestedSession.admission_at_the_limit_is_refused : ∀ (box : NestedSession.Mailbox) (limit : Nat), limit ≤ NestedSession.mailboxDepth box → NestedSession.boundedAdmit box limit = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.dequeue_restores_admission_room
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 dequeue/accounting pair: the admission refused at the limit is accepted after one accounted dequeue
theorems.statement: NestedSession.dequeue_restores_admission_room : ∀ (box : NestedSession.Mailbox) (limit : Nat), 0 < limit → NestedSession.mailboxDepth box = limit → (NestedSession.boundedAdmit box limit).isNone = true ∧ (NestedSession.boundedAdmit (NestedSession.dequeue box) limit).isSome = true

theorems.name: NestedSession.unchecked_admission_breaks_the_bound
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 control: an admission that ignores the limit derives a depth past the bound, so the bounded operand is load-bearing
theorems.statement: NestedSession.unchecked_admission_breaks_the_bound : NestedSession.mailboxDepth (NestedSession.uncheckedAdmit { enqueued := 0, dequeued := 0 }) = 1 ∧ ¬NestedSession.mailboxDepth (NestedSession.uncheckedAdmit { enqueued := 0, dequeued := 0 }) ≤ 0

theorems.name: NestedSession.step_acts_only_inside_the_current_protocol
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: no action outside the current protocol -- a successful step is exactly a resolved current node declaring that action, and its sole successor is that node's declared continuation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.step_acts_only_inside_the_current_protocol : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (depth : Nat) (endpoint successor : NestedSession.Endpoint) (action : NestedSession.Action), NestedSession.step definitions depth endpoint action = some successor → ∃ node continuation, NestedSession.resolve definitions depth endpoint.state = some node ∧ NestedSession.continuationOf action node = some continuation ∧ NestedSession.advance endpoint continuation = some successor

theorems.name: NestedSession.handshake_resolves_without_unfolding
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 finite-handshake control: the ordinary handshake resolves at unfolding depth zero, node by node
theorems.statement: NestedSession.handshake_resolves_without_unfolding : NestedSession.resolve NestedSession.handshakeProtocol 0 0 = some (NestedSession.Node.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64 1) ∧ NestedSession.resolve NestedSession.handshakeProtocol 0 1 = some (NestedSession.Node.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64 2) ∧ NestedSession.resolve NestedSession.handshakeProtocol 0 2 = some NestedSession.Node.finished

theorems.name: NestedSession.handshake_trace_advances
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 finite-handshake control: its two guest actions advance through it and finish
theorems.statement: NestedSession.handshake_trace_advances : ((NestedSession.step NestedSession.handshakeProtocol 0 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } (NestedSession.Action.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64)).bind fun mid => NestedSession.step NestedSession.handshakeProtocol 0 mid (NestedSession.Action.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64)) = some { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 2, generation := 4, closed := false }

theorems.name: NestedSession.nested_entry_refused_at_depth_zero
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: the nested fixture is not representable at depth zero while the handshake is, so the recursive entry needs an external stack rather than a wider finite table
theorems.statement: NestedSession.nested_entry_refused_at_depth_zero : NestedSession.resolve NestedSession.exampleProtocol 0 2 = none ∧ NestedSession.resolve NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 2 = some (NestedSession.Node.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64 1)

theorems.name: NestedSession.every_operation_preserves_the_endpoint_inventory
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: every modelled operation (session step, boundary, observed cleanup) preserves the endpoint inventory, including the two that carry no transition
theorems.statement: NestedSession.every_operation_preserves_the_endpoint_inventory : ∀ (session : NestedSession.Session) (operation : NestedSession.Operation), (NestedSession.applyOperation session operation).endpoints = session.endpoints

theorems.name: NestedSession.every_operation_keeps_the_endpoint_inventory_bound
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: hence no operation increases the endpoint inventory, whether or not it carries a transition
theorems.statement: NestedSession.every_operation_keeps_the_endpoint_inventory_bound : ∀ (session : NestedSession.Session) (operation : NestedSession.Operation), (NestedSession.applyOperation session operation).endpoints.length ≤ session.endpoints.length

theorems.name: NestedSession.duplicating_operation_breaks_the_bound
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 control: an operation that appends an endpoint duplicates one and breaks the bound, so the preserved inventory is load-bearing
theorems.statement: NestedSession.duplicating_operation_breaks_the_bound : ¬(NestedSession.duplicatingOperation { endpoints := [{ channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }], queued := 0, queueLimit := 3 }).endpoints.length ≤ { endpoints := [{ channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }], queued := 0, queueLimit := 3 }.endpoints.length

theorems.name: NestedSession.guest_local_progress_on_a_declared_action
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 scoped progress: at an open owned endpoint whose resolved node declares the requested action, that action has a successor -- peer, scheduler, queue and delivery are outside the statement
theorems.statement: NestedSession.guest_local_progress_on_a_declared_action : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (depth : Nat) (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint) (action : NestedSession.Action) (node : NestedSession.Node) (continuation : Nat), endpoint.closed = false → NestedSession.resolve definitions depth endpoint.state = some node → NestedSession.continuationOf action node = some continuation → ∃ successor, NestedSession.step definitions depth endpoint action = some successor

theorems.name: NestedSession.offer_state_declares_only_its_branch_receipt
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 scoped progress: at an external choice the guest’s only action is receiving the declared branch; any other action or branch has no continuation, and whether the peer selects is the peer’s premise
theorems.statement: NestedSession.offer_state_declares_only_its_branch_receipt : ∀ (branch continuation : Nat) (action : NestedSession.Action) (next : Nat), NestedSession.continuationOf action (NestedSession.Node.offer branch continuation) = some next → action = NestedSession.Action.receiveBranch branch ∧ next = continuation

theorems.name: NestedSession.finished_state_declares_no_guest_action
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 scoped progress: a finished protocol declares no guest action, so progress ends in a named terminal state
theorems.statement: NestedSession.finished_state_declares_no_guest_action : ∀ (action : NestedSession.Action), NestedSession.continuationOf action NestedSession.Node.finished = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.stackAdvance_keeps_the_stack
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: a communication continuation preserves the saved return stack and declared limit
theorems.statement: NestedSession.stackAdvance_keeps_the_stack : ∀ (state next : NestedSession.StackState) (continuation : Nat), NestedSession.stackAdvance state continuation = some next → next.returnStack = state.returnStack ∧ next.stackLimit = state.stackLimit

theorems.name: NestedSession.stackAdvance_respects_the_limit
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: a successful communication continuation stays within an already valid stack limit
theorems.statement: NestedSession.stackAdvance_respects_the_limit : ∀ (state next : NestedSession.StackState) (continuation : Nat), state.returnStack.length ≤ state.stackLimit → NestedSession.stackAdvance state continuation = some next → next.stackLimit = state.stackLimit ∧ next.returnStack.length ≤ next.stackLimit

theorems.name: NestedSession.stackState_within_the_limit
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: a successor carrying a bounded return stack preserves the declared limit
theorems.statement: NestedSession.stackState_within_the_limit : ∀ (state next : NestedSession.StackState) (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint) (stack : List Nat), stack.length ≤ state.stackLimit → { endpoint := endpoint, returnStack := stack, stackLimit := state.stackLimit } = next → next.stackLimit = state.stackLimit ∧ next.returnStack.length ≤ next.stackLimit

theorems.name: NestedSession.stackEnter_respects_the_limit
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a successful nested entry adds one frame without exceeding the declared limit
theorems.statement: NestedSession.stackEnter_respects_the_limit : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (state next : NestedSession.StackState), (NestedSession.stackEnter definitions state).snd = some next → next.stackLimit = state.stackLimit ∧ next.returnStack.length ≤ next.stackLimit

theorems.name: NestedSession.stack_step_respects_the_limit
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 invariant: every successful stack step preserves the limit and stays within it from a bounded input stack
theorems.statement: NestedSession.stack_step_respects_the_limit : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (state : NestedSession.StackState) (action : NestedSession.StackAction) (next : NestedSession.StackState), state.returnStack.length ≤ state.stackLimit → NestedSession.stackStep definitions state action = some next → next.stackLimit = state.stackLimit ∧ next.returnStack.length ≤ next.stackLimit

theorems.name: NestedSession.stack_entry_and_return_at_depth_one
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: one bounded nested entry saves and later pops its return continuation
theorems.statement: NestedSession.stack_entry_and_return_at_depth_one : NestedSession.runStack NestedSession.balancedProtocol { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 2 } [NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.enter, NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.skipNested, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish] = some { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 3, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 2 }

theorems.name: NestedSession.stack_entry_and_return_at_depth_two
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: two nested entries return in last-in-first-out order
theorems.statement: NestedSession.stack_entry_and_return_at_depth_two : NestedSession.runStack NestedSession.balancedProtocol { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 2 } [NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.enter, NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.enter, NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.skipNested, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish] = some { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 3, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 2 }

theorems.name: NestedSession.stack_push_beyond_the_limit_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: a return-stack push at the declared limit is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.balanced_trace_send_two_recv_two_is_accepted

theorems.name: NestedSession.balanced_trace_send_two_recv_three_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: an extra receive after two sends is refused
theorems.statement: NestedSession.balanced_trace_send_two_recv_three_is_refused : NestedSession.acceptedStackTrace NestedSession.balancedProtocol { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 2 } [NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.enter, NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.skipNested, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64] = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.balanced_trace_send_three_recv_two_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: two receives cannot close a three-send trace
theorems.statement: NestedSession.balanced_trace_send_three_recv_two_is_refused : NestedSession.acceptedStackTrace NestedSession.balancedProtocol { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 2 } [NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.enter, NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.enter, NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.skipNested, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish] = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.dropped_return_continuation_accepts_unbalanced_and_rejects_balanced
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 load-bearing mutant: dropping the saved continuation accepts an unbalanced trace, refuses the balanced trace, and the real stack refuses that unbalanced trace
theorems.statement: NestedSession.dropped_return_continuation_accepts_unbalanced_and_rejects_balanced : NestedSession.acceptedStackTraceDroppingReturn NestedSession.balancedProtocol { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 2 } [NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.enter, NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.skipNested, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish] = some { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 3, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 2 } ∧ NestedSession.acceptedStackTraceDroppingReturn NestedSession.balancedProtocol { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 2 } [NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.enter, NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.skipNested, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish] = none ∧ NestedSession.acceptedStackTrace NestedSession.balancedProtocol { endpoint := { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false }, returnStack := [], stackLimit := 2 } [NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.enter, NestedSession.StackAction.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.skipNested, NestedSession.StackAction.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64, NestedSession.StackAction.finish] = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.environmentStep_of_ready

theorems.statement: NestedSession.environmentStep_of_ready : ∀ (env : NestedSession.Environment) (action : NestedSession.Action), NestedSession.EnvironmentReady env action → ∃ next, NestedSession.environmentStep env action = some next

theorems.name: NestedSession.progress_under_explicit_premises
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 scoped progress: an open owned endpoint whose resolved node declares the action steps when scheduled, host-admitted and queue/peer ready
theorems.statement: NestedSession.progress_under_explicit_premises : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (depth : Nat) (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint) (env : NestedSession.Environment) (action : NestedSession.Action) (node : NestedSession.Node) (continuation : Nat), endpoint.closed = false → NestedSession.resolve definitions depth endpoint.state = some node → NestedSession.continuationOf action node = some continuation → env.scheduled = true → env.hostAdmits = true → NestedSession.EnvironmentReady env action → ∃ successor next, NestedSession.stepIn definitions depth endpoint env action = some (successor, next)

theorems.name: NestedSession.progress_fixture_send_then_receive

theorems.name: NestedSession.unscheduled_guest_takes_no_step
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 scheduler premise is load-bearing: an unscheduled guest takes no step

theorems.name: NestedSession.host_refusal_takes_no_step
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 host premise is load-bearing: a host refusal stops the step
theorems.statement: NestedSession.host_refusal_takes_no_step : NestedSession.stepIn NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } (have __src := NestedSession.readyEnvironment; { outbox := __src.outbox, outboxLimit := __src.outboxLimit, inbox := __src.inbox, peerBranch := __src.peerBranch, scheduled := __src.scheduled, hostAdmits := false }) (NestedSession.Action.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64) = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.full_outbox_refuses_send

theorems.statement: NestedSession.full_outbox_refuses_send : NestedSession.stepIn NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } (have __src := NestedSession.readyEnvironment; { outbox := { enqueued := 1, dequeued := 0 }, outboxLimit := __src.outboxLimit, inbox := __src.inbox, peerBranch := __src.peerBranch, scheduled := __src.scheduled, hostAdmits := __src.hostAdmits }) (NestedSession.Action.send NestedSession.MessageType.i64) = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.silent_peer_leaves_receive_pending
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 peer premise is load-bearing: an empty inbox leaves the receive pending
theorems.statement: NestedSession.silent_peer_leaves_receive_pending : NestedSession.stepIn NestedSession.exampleProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := false, protocol := 9, state := 1, generation := 4, closed := false } (have __src := NestedSession.readyEnvironment; { outbox := __src.outbox, outboxLimit := __src.outboxLimit, inbox := { enqueued := 0, dequeued := 0 }, peerBranch := __src.peerBranch, scheduled := __src.scheduled, hostAdmits := __src.hostAdmits }) (NestedSession.Action.recv NestedSession.MessageType.i64) = none

theorems.name: NestedSession.branch_receipt_needs_the_peer_selection
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 peer premise for external choice: only the branch the peer selected is received
theorems.statement: NestedSession.branch_receipt_needs_the_peer_selection : NestedSession.stepIn NestedSession.offerProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 0, generation := 4, closed := false } (have __src := NestedSession.readyEnvironment; { outbox := __src.outbox, outboxLimit := __src.outboxLimit, inbox := __src.inbox, peerBranch := some 1, scheduled := __src.scheduled, hostAdmits := __src.hostAdmits }) (NestedSession.Action.receiveBranch 0) = none ∧ (NestedSession.stepIn NestedSession.offerProtocol 2 { channel := 5, responder := true, protocol := 9, state := 1, generation := 4, closed := false } (have __src := NestedSession.readyEnvironment; { outbox := __src.outbox, outboxLimit := __src.outboxLimit, inbox := __src.inbox, peerBranch := some 1, scheduled := __src.scheduled, hostAdmits := __src.hostAdmits }) (NestedSession.Action.receiveBranch 1)).isSome = true

theorems.name: NestedSession.stackStep_eq_protoStep
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01 the configuration step is the model stack step on an open endpoint

theorems.name: NestedSession.mem_enabled_iff
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01 an action is listed as enabled exactly when the configuration step takes it
theorems.statement: NestedSession.mem_enabled_iff : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (limit : Nat) (config : NestedSession.Config) (action : NestedSession.StackAction), action ∈ NestedSession.enabled definitions limit config ↔ (NestedSession.protoStep definitions limit config action).isSome = true

theorems.name: NestedSession.runProto_snoc
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01 running a trace with one more action takes one more configuration step
theorems.statement: NestedSession.runProto_snoc : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (limit : Nat) (trace : List NestedSession.StackAction) (action : NestedSession.StackAction) (config : NestedSession.Config), NestedSession.runProto definitions limit config (trace ++ [action]) = (NestedSession.runProto definitions limit config trace).bind fun last => NestedSession.protoStep definitions limit last action

theorems.name: NestedSession.runStack_eq_runProto
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01 the configuration run is the model stack run on an open endpoint
theorems.statement: NestedSession.runStack_eq_runProto : ∀ (definitions : List NestedSession.Node) (limit : Nat) (trace : List NestedSession.StackAction) (endpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint) (stack : List Nat), endpoint.closed = false → NestedSession.runStack definitions { endpoint := endpoint, returnStack := stack, stackLimit := limit } trace = Option.map (fun config => { endpoint := { channel := endpoint.channel, responder := endpoint.responder, protocol := endpoint.protocol, state := config.fst, generation := endpoint.generation, closed := endpoint.closed }, returnStack := config.snd, stackLimit := limit }) (NestedSession.runProto definitions limit (endpoint.state, stack) trace)

theorems.name: NestedSession.distinguish_none
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01 no distinguishing action means both sides list the same actions
theorems.statement: NestedSession.distinguish_none : ∀ (left right : List NestedSession.StackAction), NestedSession.distinguish left right = none → ∀ (action : NestedSession.StackAction), action ∈ left ↔ action ∈ right

theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01 a distinguishing action is listed on exactly one side
theorems.statement: NestedSession.distinguish_some : ∀ (left right : List NestedSession.StackAction) (action : NestedSession.StackAction), NestedSession.distinguish left right = some action → action ∈ left ∧ ¬action ∈ right ∨ action ∈ right ∧ ¬action ∈ left

theorems.name: NestedSession.exhaustion_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01 a work bound that runs out with a pair pending is refused as exhausted, never equal
theorems.statement: NestedSession.exhaustion_is_refused : ∀ (left : List NestedSession.Node) (leftLimit : Nat) (right : List NestedSession.Node) (rightLimit : Nat) (assumed : List (NestedSession.Config × NestedSession.Config)) (entry : NestedSession.Pending) (rest : List NestedSession.Pending), NestedSession.checkPairs left leftLimit right rightLimit 0 assumed (entry :: rest) = NestedSession.Verdict.exhausted

theorems.name: NestedSession.assumed_pairs_observe_alike
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01 pairs closed under assumption observe every trace alike
theorems.statement: NestedSession.assumed_pairs_observe_alike : ∀ (left : List NestedSession.Node) (leftLimit : Nat) (right : List NestedSession.Node) (rightLimit : Nat) (assumed : List (NestedSession.Config × NestedSession.Config)), (NestedSession.Assumed left leftLimit right rightLimit assumed fun x => x ∈ assumed) → ∀ (trace : List NestedSession.StackAction) (pair : NestedSession.Config × NestedSession.Config), pair ∈ assumed → NestedSession.observe left leftLimit pair.fst trace = NestedSession.observe right rightLimit pair.snd trace

theorems.name: NestedSession.checkPairs_equal
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01 an equal verdict yields a closed set of consistent pairs containing every visited and pending pair
theorems.statement: NestedSession.checkPairs_equal : ∀ (left : List NestedSession.Node) (leftLimit : Nat) (right : List NestedSession.Node) (rightLimit work : Nat) (assumed : List (NestedSession.Config × NestedSession.Config)) (pending : List NestedSession.Pending), (NestedSession.Assumed left leftLimit right rightLimit assumed fun pair => pair ∈ assumed ∨ ∃ trace, (pair, trace) ∈ pending) → NestedSession.checkPairs left leftLimit right rightLimit work assumed pending = NestedSession.Verdict.equal → ∃ closure, (NestedSession.Assumed left leftLimit right rightLimit closure fun x => x ∈ closure) ∧ (∀ (pair : NestedSession.Config × NestedSession.Config), pair ∈ assumed → pair ∈ closure) ∧ ∀ (entry : NestedSession.Pending), entry ∈ pending → entry.fst ∈ closure

theorems.name: NestedSession.protocolEquality_sound

theorems.statement: NestedSession.protocolEquality_sound : ∀ (left : List NestedSession.Node) (leftLimit : Nat) (right : List NestedSession.Node) (rightLimit work : Nat) (start other : NestedSession.Config), NestedSession.protocolEquality left leftLimit right rightLimit work start other = NestedSession.Verdict.equal → ∀ (trace : List NestedSession.StackAction), NestedSession.observe left leftLimit start trace = NestedSession.observe right rightLimit other trace

theorems.name: NestedSession.checkPairs_differ
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01 a differ verdict from reachable pending pairs carries a trace the two sides observe differently
theorems.statement: NestedSession.checkPairs_differ : ∀ (left : List NestedSession.Node) (leftLimit : Nat) (right : List NestedSession.Node) (rightLimit : Nat) (start other : NestedSession.Config) (work : Nat) (assumed : List (NestedSession.Config × NestedSession.Config)) (pending : List NestedSession.Pending) (witness : List NestedSession.StackAction), (∀ (entry : NestedSession.Pending), entry ∈ pending → NestedSession.runProto left leftLimit start entry.snd = some entry.fst.fst ∧ NestedSession.runProto right rightLimit other entry.snd = some entry.fst.snd) → NestedSession.checkPairs left leftLimit right rightLimit work assumed pending = NestedSession.Verdict.differ witness → NestedSession.observe left leftLimit start witness ≠ NestedSession.observe right rightLimit other witness

theorems.name: NestedSession.protocolEquality_witness

theorems.statement: NestedSession.protocolEquality_witness : ∀ (left : List NestedSession.Node) (leftLimit : Nat) (right : List NestedSession.Node) (rightLimit work : Nat) (start other : NestedSession.Config) (witness : List NestedSession.StackAction), NestedSession.protocolEquality left leftLimit right rightLimit work start other = NestedSession.Verdict.differ witness → NestedSession.observe left leftLimit start witness ≠ NestedSession.observe right rightLimit other witness

theorems.name: NestedSession.equal_protocols_run_alike

theorems.statement: NestedSession.equal_protocols_run_alike : ∀ (left : List NestedSession.Node) (leftLimit : Nat) (right : List NestedSession.Node) (rightLimit work : Nat) (leftEndpoint rightEndpoint : NestedSession.Endpoint) (leftStack rightStack : List Nat), leftEndpoint.closed = false → rightEndpoint.closed = false → NestedSession.protocolEquality left leftLimit right rightLimit work (leftEndpoint.state, leftStack) (rightEndpoint.state, rightStack) = NestedSession.Verdict.equal → ∀ (trace : List NestedSession.StackAction), (NestedSession.runStack left { endpoint := leftEndpoint, returnStack := leftStack, stackLimit := leftLimit } trace).isSome = (NestedSession.runStack right { endpoint := rightEndpoint, returnStack := rightStack, stackLimit := rightLimit } trace).isSome

theorems.statement: NestedSession.StackAction.dual_dual : ∀ (action : NestedSession.StackAction), action.dual.dual = action

theorems.name: NestedSession.protocolDuality_sound

theorems.statement: NestedSession.protocolDuality_sound : ∀ (left : List NestedSession.Node) (leftLimit : Nat) (right : List NestedSession.Node) (rightLimit work : Nat) (start other : NestedSession.Config), NestedSession.protocolDuality left leftLimit right rightLimit work start other = NestedSession.Verdict.equal → ∀ (trace : List NestedSession.StackAction), NestedSession.observe left leftLimit start trace = NestedSession.observe right rightLimit other (List.map NestedSession.StackAction.dual trace)

The definitions table is handwritten. No lowering, runtime, scheduler, queue or peer correspondence is claimed;
